info.title: Customer Journey
info.description: Customer Journey is used to retrieve information about Engagements and Conversations that have occurred in a Customer's Journey and to configure what Identifiers should be collected as part of a Customer's Journey.

license.name: Avaya Software Development Kit (SDK) Software License Terms

tags.name: Engagement
tags.description: Represents a resource of the Contact Center being allocated. Engagements can be assigned to one or many Conversations, although this is not mandatory.

tags.name: Identifiers
tags.description: Represents the criteria with which a customer may be identified (Phone numbers, e-mail addresses, social media handles).

tags.name: Journey
tags.description: Represents the history of Conversations and Engagements that a Customer has had with the business.

get.description:
**This API requires the Agent role.**

Gets a list of Engagements by querying by their Engagement ids. The Engagements are returned in the same order as the ids are supplied.

Only Engagements that can be found will be included in the resulting response. If none of the Engagements can be found, then a 404 Not Found response will be returned instead.

parameters.name: engagementIds
parameters.description: A comma-separated list of Engagement id's.

Bad Request. 

* accountId must be exactly 6 characters

* pageNumber must be greater than 0

* pageSize must be between 1 and 50

* engagementIds size must be between 1 and 50

* engagementIds must be 36 character UUIDs

post.description:
**This API requires the Agent role.**

Searches for Customer Journeys optionally using different specific filters. 

It makes it possible to narrow the search down to a particular conversation and only return the parts of the Customer's Journey that satisfies the given filter criteria. 

The filter can include fields such as:
  * identifiers
  * channelIds
  * agentId
  * conversation
  * startDate & endDate

If found, the Customer's Journey will include a list of all the Engagements a Customer has had with the Contact Center, ordered by the `startDate` in descending order.

400.description:
Bad Request.

* accountId must be exactly 6 characters

* pageNumber must be greater than 0

* pageSize must be between 1 and 50

* Invalid input, 'Identifiers' must not be empty

post.description:
Creates a new Customer Journey Identity grouping, the supplied "identifiers" will be linked together to form a single Customer Journey Identity. If any of the identifiers already exist, then any links they have will also be included.
Note: This can be used to link previously unassociated identifiers together improving the accuracy of any searches involving them. Creating Journey this way **will not affect AXP's Digital Workflow** , its only internal to Customer Journey.

400.description:
Bad Request. 

* accountId must be exactly 6 characters

* Request has invalid input

post.description:
Unlinks an identifier from a Customer Journey, the supplied **unlinkIdentifier** will be unlinked from the rest of the provided identifiers. The updated state of identifiers will be returned in the response.
This can be used to unlink previously associated identifiers to improve the accuracy of any searches involving them.
Note: This does not delete the identifier, instead it simply "unlinks" it from any other associated identifiers. It can still be used as part of a search.
And this way unlinking identifier from Customer Journey **will not affect AXP's Digital Workflow** , its only internal to Customer Journey.

requestBody.description: Unlink an identifier from a Customer Journey.

400.description:
Bad Request. 

* accountId must be exactly 6 characters

* Request has invalid input

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of results per page

parameters.name: orderBy
parameters.description:
Ordering is performed on the "leftAt" field, the default order is descending.

To specify ascending order, "asc" should be used.

post.description:
Lists the Agents to have participated on a Customer's Journey for the required Channel within a timeframe. By default this is limited to the last 30 days unless a "startDate" for the search is provided.

The Agents are listed in descending order based on the "leftAt" timefield, this can be changed to ascending with the optional "orderBy" parameter.

This does not include any Agents that are currently active on the Customer's Journey that have yet to leave.

schema.description: A list containing Agents from a Customer's Journey that match the search criteria.

400.description:
Bad Request. 

* accountId must be exactly 6 characters

* pageSize must be between 1 and 10

* orderBy must have value 'asc' or 'desc'

post.description:
**This API requires the Account Administrator role.**

Creates a new identifier that can then be used to uniquely identify a Customer's Journey. 

This will instruct Customer Journey to collect and store identifier values that match the configured name on Customer Journeys that contain it. Unless configured to, Customer Journey will not collect identifiers for names it does not recognise.

Identifiers can be classified as WEAK, STRONG, or VERY STRONG. For example, a phone number is considered a WEAK identifier while an email is considered a STRONG identifier.

The name of the identifier must be unique for the Account, attempts to create duplicate identifiers will be rejected. A maximum of 1000 identifiers can be configured for an Account.

400.description:
Bad Request. 

* accountId must be exactly 6 characters

* name must not be empty

* displayName must not be empty

* identifierStrength must be WEAK, STRONG, or VERY STRONG

* identifier 'NAME' already exists for account 'ACCOUNT_NAME'

post.description:
**This API requires the Account Administrator role.**

Deletes the specified identifier(s), meaning they will no longer be collected and stored against Customer Journeys. 

This has no effect for Customer Journeys that already contain the identifier(s).
